Composable shadcn/ui blocks — Kanban, Gantt, code blocks, editors — installable through the shadcn CLI.

Source: [Kibo UI](https://github.com/haydenbleasel/kibo) by Hayden Bleasel — MIT.

Publishes its own shadcn registry, so installs come straight from them and stay current.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://www.kibo-ui.com/registry/kanban.json
```
